enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Remains still. Turns to side. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and personal washing
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on WaterHeater. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Washes hair. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Turns on sink tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Wipes face with towel.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs, milk, and bread. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Picks up pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Picks up plate. Puts eggs on plate. Picks up bread. Puts bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Waits for toast. Spreads butter on toast. Pours milk into glass. Picks up fork. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk. Stands up. Picks up plate and glass. Walks to sink. Rinses plate and glass. Places in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking the weather forecast for the evening storm on Phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Selects shirt and pants. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens weather app. Checks forecast. Reads storm updates. Closes app. Puts phone in pocket. Checks mirror. Adjusts shirt. Picks up bag. Walks out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Arrives at hospital stop. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to hospital entrance. Enters hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Checks patient charts. Enters patient room. Greets patient. Takes vital signs. Administers medication. Changes bandages. Assists patient with mobility. Communicates with colleagues. Updates patient notes. Washes hands. Moves to next patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects food. Pays for food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Checks phone. Throws away trash. Returns tray. Walks back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, continuing patient care and handing over notes
enriched_activities.desc: Continues patient care. Administers treatments. Monitors patients. Responds to call bells. Updates patient records. Communicates with doctors. Prepares handover notes. Meets with incoming shift. Discusses patient status. Hands over notes. Signs off. Leaves ward.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Sits down. Rides bus. Gets off at stop. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters house.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Places on counter. Picks up knife. Chops vegetables. Picks up pan. Places on stove. Turns on stove. Adds oil. Adds ingredients. Stirs. Cooks. Turns off stove. Picks up plate. Serves food. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up. Picks up plate. Walks to sink. Rinses plate. Places in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up after dinner and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up dishes. Scrapes food into trash. Rinses dishes. Opens dishwasher. Loads dishes. Adds detergent. Closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Wipes counter. Wipes stove. Sweeps floor. Throws away trash. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and following storm updates on Computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Turns on light. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Picks up computer. Opens laptop. Checks storm updates. Reads news. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Stands up. Goes to kitchen. Gets snack. Returns. Sits down. Continues watching. Checks computer again.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body. Washes hair. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around waist. Turns on sink tap. Washes face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Charging Phone and Computer, closing windows and preparing for possible power outages from the storm
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Picks up phone. Plugs phone into charger. Picks up computer. Plugs computer into charger. Walks to window. Closes window. Locks window. Checks other windows. Closes them. Picks up flashlight. Checks batteries. Places flashlight on table. Fills water bottles. Places near bed. Checks weather app.
Enters bedroom. Turns on bedside lamp. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Closes book. Places book on nightstand. Turns off lamp. Lies down in bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Sleeps.
